calibration.note: Set 2026-11-03 from three meter readings of the week that reset 2026-10-30T20:00Z, against every transcript on the machine cut to the window (ledger.mjs --all --since <reset> --until <reading> --clip): 22% at 202.3M units, 29% at 278.9M, 41% at 414.3M. 414.3M / 41 = 10.1M. Under the old weights the same readings gave 11.3M, 11.8M and 12.9M per percent, drifting more. The meter also counts requests no transcript holds (on 2026-11-03 it showed 57M more Opus cache reads and 6M more Haiku input than the transcripts), so this ratio absorbs them. Recalibrate at each retro from a fresh reading.

weights.note: Set 2026-11-03 from list prices (opus-5-5 $4/$20, sonnet-5-5 $2/$10, haiku-5-5 $0.10/$0.50, fable-5-1 $10/$50 per million input/output) and checked against the meter's dollars for session 28675dc0: its sonnet line (409.7M cache read, 8.2M cache write, 2.2M output, $83.46) fits only with cache reads at 0.05x of input and writes at 1.25x, and its opus line at those ratios gives $186 against $191.53. Fable's cache reads are 0.025x of its input, so its units overstate them twice over. Haiku prompts past 100k tokens cost 5x, which haiku 0.05 does not show.

handoff.note: ledger.mjs --self --waves <file>, at a wave boundary only: the orchestrator's last context minus a fresh session's, times the last wave's turns, as cache reads. A fresh or compacted orchestrator started at 47-69k in session 28675dc0. There, at wave 7's opening (194k), a handoff would have saved 40.4M re-read tokens over the next 302 turns, 4.0M units; at wave 6's close (216k after 95 turns) 1.5M. The threshold, a quarter of a percent of the week, hands off at the first and not the second.

unitTargetNote: Yardsticks, not caps: no agent can see its own usage, so a target changes nothing while the agent runs. The ledger flags an agent past its target for the retro to explain. Set 2026-11-03 near the 90th percentile of each role over this epic's sessions 837ef843 and 28675dc0, in the new units (builder: 29 agents, median 1.9M, p90 5.5M; fix: 56, median 0.31M, p90 0.64M; review-new-logic: 23, p90 1.8M; review-small: 28, p90 0.29M; critical read: 4, max 2.6M). What crossed them were Opus builders and steps that spanned repos. Walk had no data and was converted at the Sonnet ratio (0.6). Mechanical and orchestrator are kept: one mechanical ran (0.13M), and the orchestrator of 28675dc0 came to 31.7M, about 4M of it from the handoff missed at wave 7.
